verdict.rationale:
TruffleHog's CLI can scan across an entire GitHub org, Docker images, and many source types in a single invocation (e.g. `--org=trufflesecurity`, scanning git/chats/wikis/logs/object stores), which constitutes bulk operations across many repos/items at once, and verification is batch-applied across all detected secrets. However there's no evidence of an API/SDK for programmatic bulk operations tailored to AI-agent workflows, nor documentation of large-scale parallel batch processing controls.
missing for 10: programmatic bulk API for agents, explicit batch-size/parallelism controls, evidence of scale testing across thousands of items.
